public_domain_references.bsb: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,
public_domain_references.web: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
public_domain_references.asv: But when the kindness of God our Saviour, and his love toward man, appeared,
public_domain_references.kjv: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,

pob.text: not from works done in righteousness, which we ourselves did, but according to his mercy he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewal by the Holy Spirit,

spob.text: He saved us—not because of righteous deeds we ourselves had done, but because of his mercy. He saved us through the washing of rebirth[a] and renewal by the Holy Spirit.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
public_domain_references.web: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
public_domain_references.asv: not by works [done] in righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,
public_domain_references.kjv: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

pob.text: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus the Messiah our Savior[b][a],

spob.text: He poured the Holy Spirit out on us in abundance through Jesus the Messiah, our Savior.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: This is the Spirit He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
public_domain_references.web: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
public_domain_references.asv: which he poured out upon us richly, through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
public_domain_references.kjv: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

pob.text: so that[a], having been justified by his grace[b], we might become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

spob.text: By his grace, we have been justified,[a] so that we might become heirs in hope of eternal life.

public_domain_references.bsb: so that, having been justified by His grace, we would become heirs with the hope of eternal life.
public_domain_references.web: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
public_domain_references.asv: that, being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
public_domain_references.kjv: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

pob.text: This saying is trustworthy[a], and concerning these things I want you to insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to devote themselves to good works[b]. These things are good and beneficial for people.

spob.text: This saying can be trusted. I want you to emphasize these things with confidence[a] so that those who have believed God[b] may take care to devote themselves to good works. These things are good and benefit people.

public_domain_references.bsb: This saying is trustworthy. And I want you to emphasize these things, so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds. These things are excellent and profitable for the people.
public_domain_references.web: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
public_domain_references.asv: Faithful is the saying, and concerning these things I desire that thou affirm confidently, to the end that they who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men:
public_domain_references.kjv: [This is] a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

pob.text: But avoid foolish controversies and genealogies and strife and quarrels about the law[b][a], for they are unprofitable and futile.

spob.text: But avoid foolish controversies, debates about genealogies,[a] conflict, and quarrels about the law. They do no good and lead nowhere.

public_domain_references.bsb: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, and quarrels about the law, because these things are pointless and worthless.
public_domain_references.web: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
public_domain_references.asv: but shun foolish questionings, and genealogies, and strifes, and fightings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
public_domain_references.kjv: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

pob.text: Reject a divisive person after a first and second warning,[a]

spob.text: Warn anyone who causes divisions. Warn them a second time. After that, reject them.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition,
public_domain_references.web: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
public_domain_references.asv: A factious man after a first and second admonition refuse;
public_domain_references.kjv: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;

pob.text: knowing that such a person is warped and is sinning[c][b][a], being self-condemned.

spob.text: You know that such a man has become warped and keeps sinning. He has brought condemnation on himself.

public_domain_references.bsb: knowing that such a man is corrupt and sinful; he is self-condemned.
public_domain_references.web: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
public_domain_references.asv: knowing that such a one is perverted, and sinneth, being self-condemned.
public_domain_references.kjv: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.

pob.text: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you[a], make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis[b], for I have decided to spend the winter there.

spob.text: When I send either Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me in Nicopolis, because I have decided to stay there for the winter.

public_domain_references.bsb: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.
public_domain_references.web: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
public_domain_references.asv: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, give diligence to come unto me to Nicopolis: for there I have determined to winter.
public_domain_references.kjv: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

pob.text: Diligently send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way[a], so that they may lack nothing.

spob.text: Make every effort to help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey, so that they have everything they need.

public_domain_references.bsb: Do your best to equip Zenas the lawyer and Apollos, so that they will have everything they need.
public_domain_references.web: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
public_domain_references.asv: Set forward Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
public_domain_references.kjv: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

pob.text: And let our people also learn to engage in good works for necessary needs[c][b][a], so that they may not be unfruitful.

spob.text: Our people should also learn to devote themselves to good works that meet essential needs, so that they may not be unfruitful.

public_domain_references.bsb: And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not be unfruitful.
public_domain_references.web: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
public_domain_references.asv: And let our [people] also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
public_domain_references.kjv: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

pob.text: All who are with me greet you[a]. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with all of you.

spob.text: Everyone here with me sends you greetings. Greet those who love us in our shared faith.[a] May grace be with every one of you.

public_domain_references.bsb: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with all of you.
public_domain_references.web: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
public_domain_references.asv: All that are with me salute thee. Salute them that love us in faith. Grace be with you all.
public_domain_references.kjv: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace [be] with you all. Amen.
